outcome: Deterioration in muscle strength during pregnancy
cohort: 305 women with 26 different genetic neuromuscular diseases reporting on 721 pregnancies
finding: Women with neuromuscular conditions experience a higher frequency of miscarriage, caesarean delivery, instrumental vaginal delivery, falls during pregnancy, and deterioration in muscle strength compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery and instrumental vaginal delivery rates were higher in women with neuromuscular conditions compared to the general population.
